mir.text: Jamuraa is first united by Mangara, who makes a peace agreement between its rival nations and sets a buffer zone policed by Quirion elves.
Kaervek resents the peace, persuades Jolrael that Mangara plans domination, and then he and Jolrael ambush Mangara and seal him in an Amber Prison.
With Mangara gone, the peace unravels and Kaervek's forces plunge the nations into the Mirage War, while Zhalfir, Femeref and Suq'Ata unite against him.

vis.text: Jamuraa is tainted by Kaervek, who imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy and now spoils the land simply out of spite.
Jolrael, having seen the horrors Kaervek has freed, foresees a betrayal of either Kaervek or Jamuraa.

pcy.text: Jamuraa suffers a Keldon invasion in the Prophecy War, as the Keldons raid the coast, take hostages and settle, and the Kipamu League cannot resist.
Teferi sends Barrin to reorganize the League, and Rayne discovers Greel is the source of the Phyrexian plague, though Greel kills her.
Barrin dissolves Greel with a spark spell and executes the crushed Latulla, and the embittered Barrin and shaken Teferi turn away from Urza's plan.

tsb.text: Jamuraa appears as a land that Jolrael claims as her army.
